title: Unit Event — This Moment With You! — Episode4 Our First Band

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need's debut single is taking off. Thanks to the impact of their VIRTUAL SINGER version, their label expresses hopes that the band will create VIRTUAL SINGER versions of all future songs. But Ichika seems hesitant...

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: N-No, it sounds funny when I play it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Father
rows.Line: Oh, your fingers are touching the other strings. Try curling your fingers a bit more so you're only pressing the strings you want to fret.

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Father
rows.Line:
Yes, that's it!
You're such a quick study, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, I think I've memorized all the basic chords you told me about.

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: I'm still having trouble playing a couple of them, but...

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Father
rows.Line:
Haha. That's okay.
Now you just have to practice and get your fingers to remember where they need to be for each chord.

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Father
rows.Line: You can also practice by learning any songs that you'd like to try playing.

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, then! I want to try playing this song, Dad!

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line:
It's a Hatsune Miku song!
Shiho and the others said they'd try playing it with me, so I had Mom print out the sheet music for it...!

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Also, I want to learn how to sing while playing it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, you're going to sing?
But this song looks pretty tricky.
You might need to practice quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line:
Th-That's okay...!
I learned how to play those chords today, so I'm going to keep practicing lots and lots.

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Father
rows.Line:
Then, let's learn it bit by bit.
I'll do my best to help you where I can.

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line:
Listen, everyone!
I learned how to play some guitar chords yesterday!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: I can play a part of that song now after asking my mom for some help.

rows.Speaker: Music Teacher
rows.Line: Oh, Mochizuki, you're getting pretty good with that snare drum. Your drum rolls sound much cleaner.

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: I was worried that I wouldn't be able to move my hands and feet at the same time, but I feel more comfortable with the snare now thanks to you.

rows.Speaker: Music Teacher
rows.Line: Hehe. Your hard work is simply paying off, Mochizuki. You've improved quite a lot since you seem to be able to keep a steady rhythm now.

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, also...!
Umm, as for my feet... I'd like to learn how to play the bass drum...!

rows.Speaker: Music Teacher
rows.Line:
Yes, I can show you how.
Let's learn how to create a beat with your foot. First, remember what we covered when playing the snare drum...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: (Our sounds are all mixing together. We're playing as one...!)

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: (So this is what it's like to be in a band...)

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line:
(U-Uh oh... What part are we on now...?
I think I'm lost... Umm...)

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: (Saki and Ichika are also making a bunch of mistakes, which is making them fall behind...)

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: (But I guess we can keep going until the end, since they all seem to be having fun...)

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: What?! But that was my best run since I started practicing this song!

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry, Shiho!
I got lost and forgot what I was supposed to play partway through...

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line:
I mean, all of you made mistakes.
You were all over the place by the time we got to the middle, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah.
We weren't in sync at all. At this rate, we'll never...

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: I had a lot of fun...!

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line: Playing that Miku song with all of you was really fun!

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know what you mean...
I had fun too.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: But I don't want to leave things here.

rows.Speaker: Little Shiho
rows.Line: Since we get to play together like this, I want us to get it right.

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Then, let's try playing it again!

rows.Speaker: Little Ichika
rows.Line:
Better. A lot better...!
The four of us. As a band!
